brief:
Ahmad Tibi, a Palestinian citizen of Israel, was elected deputy speaker of the Knesset, Al Jazeera English reported. Tibi has served as a legislator for 27 years and previously worked as an aide to Yasser Arafat.

Tibi's election to the deputy speaker role places him among the highest-ranking Arab members in Israel's parliament, where Palestinian citizens hold a minority of seats.
